general_background.title: Base changes thiol speciation
general_background.summary: Changing the acidity of an aqueous thiol-capped synthesis changes the amount of thiolate available to coordinate the metal or bind the crystal surface. It can therefore alter precipitation as well as the stability of the final dispersion.
